content.name: Quickened Spell
entries: When you cast a spell that has a casting time of 1 action, you can spend 2 sorcery points to change the casting time to 1 bonus action for this casting.

content.name: Quickened Spell
entries: When you cast a spell that has a casting time of an action, you can spend 2 Sorcery Points to change the casting time to a {@variantrule Bonus Action|SRD52} for this casting. You can't modify a spell in this way if you've already cast a level 1+ spell on the current turn, nor can you cast a level 1+ spell on this turn after modifying a spell in this way.
